WSLReclaimable: Up to {size} can be reclaimed by compacting
WSLConvertMessage: The distribution stops. Converting can take a long time for large distributions.
WSLCompactMessage: WSL stops the distribution and shrinks its virtual disk to the space actually used.
WSLCompactFallbackMessage: This WSL version cannot compact by itself. WSLPilot shuts down all of WSL and runs diskpart in a separate administrator window.
WSLMoveHelp: WSL moves the virtual disk to the new folder. The distribution stops first.
WSLResizeHelp: The maximum size the disk may grow to, such as 256GB. The distribution stops first.
WSLSparseHelp: A sparse disk shrinks by itself when files are deleted. WSL marks this as experimental.
WSLUnregisterMessage: The distribution and its disk are deleted. This cannot be undone without a backup.
WSLWebDownload: Download from the internet instead of the Microsoft Store
WSLImportHelp: A tar file (from wsl --export or a root file system) or a .vhdx disk becomes a new distribution.
WSLImportVHD: The file is a virtual disk (.vhdx)
WSLExportHelp: The distribution stops first, so the copy is consistent.
CfgAdvancedHelp: Only lines you change are rewritten. The file is backed up before saving.
CfgMissing: The file does not exist yet: every setting has its default. Saving creates it.
CfgOtherKeys: Other settings in this file, kept as they are: {keys}
CfgBackupNote: The current file is backed up before it is replaced.
CfgConflict: The file changed outside WSLPilot. Reload it, then make your changes again.
CfgEffectDistro: Takes effect when {name} restarts (stop it, or wait about 8 seconds after its last window closes).
CfgEffectSession: Takes effect when the container session restarts.
CfgBootSystemdHelp: Start systemd as the init process (WSL 2).
CfgBootCommandHelp: Runs as root when the distribution starts.
CfgUserDefaultHelp: The user a new session runs as.
CfgNetHostnameHelp: Name of the distribution on the network.
CfgNetGenerateResolvHelp: Let WSL write the DNS servers.
CfgMountEnabledHelp: Mount C:, D:… under the mount folder.
CfgMountFsTabHelp: Mount the file systems listed in /etc/fstab at start.
CfgTimeZoneHelp: Keep the time zone in step with Windows.
CfgGPUEnabledHelp: Let Linux programs use the Windows GPU.
CfgMemoryHelp: Memory for the WSL 2 virtual machine, such as 8GB. Default: half of the computer's memory.
CfgSwapHelp: Swap size, 0 for none. Default: a quarter of memory.
CfgNetworkingModeHelp: nat shares the PC's address; mirrored gives Linux the same addresses as Windows.
CfgLocalhostForwardingHelp: Reach Linux servers at localhost from Windows.
CfgFirewallHelp: Apply firewall rules to WSL traffic.
CfgAutoProxyHelp: Pass the Windows HTTP proxy to Linux.
CfgVMIdleHelp: How long the VM stays on with nothing running.
CfgDefaultVHDSizeHelp: Maximum size of new distribution disks, such as 512GB.
CfgKernelHelp: Path of a custom Linux kernel.
CfgMemoryReclaimHelp: How cached memory goes back to Windows.
CfgHostLoopbackHelp: In mirrored mode, reach Windows through its own addresses.
CfgSessionCPUHelp: Processors for the container session. Default: all.
CfgSessionMemoryHelp: Memory for the container session, such as 8GB. Default: half.
CfgSessionStorageSizeHelp: Maximum size of the images and containers disk.
CfgSessionStoragePathHelp: Changing it does not move existing images or containers: a new, empty session starts there.
CfgSessionBindingHelp: 0.0.0.0 makes published ports reachable from other computers.
CfgSessionHostLoopbackHelp: Name containers use to reach Windows; none to disable.
CfgSessionIdleHelp: Seconds the session stays on when idle.
CfgCredentialStoreHelp: wincred uses Windows Credential Manager; file uses an encrypted file.
CtrPortsHelp: host:container, separated by commas. Ports bind to 127.0.0.1 unless an address is given.
CtrVolumesHelp: One per line: volume:/path or C:\folder:/path, add :ro for read-only.
CtrRestartHelp: WSL Containers cannot restart containers itself; the WSLPilot agent does it while you are signed in.
CtrRemoveMessage: The container is deleted. Named volumes are kept.
CtrPruneMessage: Every stopped container is deleted, also ones created outside WSLPilot.
ImgPruneMessage: Dangling images that no container uses are deleted.
ImgRemoveMessage: The image is deleted. Images in use by a container are not removed.
NetRemoveMessage: Containers attached to it lose this network.
VolHelp: Files move in and out of volumes as tar, unpacked inside Linux, so owners, permissions and links are kept.
VolDriverHelp: guest keeps data in the session's disk; vhd gives the volume its own virtual disk of a fixed size.
VolReplaceWarning: Everything in the volume is replaced. A safety backup is made first.
VolImportHelp: The archive is unpacked by tar inside a helper container; nothing is unpacked on Windows.
VolExportHelp: Stop containers that write to the volume first for a consistent copy.
VolImported: {count} entries imported; {found} found in the volume
VolRemoveMessage: The volume and all its data are deleted.
VolCompactMessage: All containers stop while the container session is restarted, then diskpart runs in a separate administrator window.
CmpAddHelp: Choose a compose.yaml. It stays where it is; WSLPilot only remembers where it is.
CmpHelp: Projects run on a backend chosen when they are added. A project never moves to another backend by itself.
CmpDownMessage: The project's containers and networks are removed. Volumes are kept unless you choose otherwise.
CmpRemoveVolumesWarning: The data in the volumes is deleted.
CmpAutostartHelp: The WSLPilot agent brings the project up when you sign in.
CmpValid: The project is valid for this backend.
CmpRemoveMessage: WSLPilot forgets the project. Its files, containers and volumes are not touched.
BkRestoreHelp: Everything restorable from every location, including backups from other computers and plain tar files. Outside locations are read-only.
BkNoteNoMeta: Not made by WSLPilot: where it came from and whether it was consistent are unknown.
BkNoteVHDX: A disk image restores only as a new distribution.
BkVerifyFailed: The backup failed its check, so nothing was restored
BkRestoreFilesHelp: Files keep their owners and permissions. Existing files with the same names are overwritten.
BkRestoreOverMessage: The current state is backed up first, then replaced by this backup.
BkDeleteMessage: The backup files are deleted from this location.
BkPlansHelp: Plans make backups on a schedule. Backups stay restorable even after a plan is deleted.
BkAgentMissing: Plans only run while WSLPilot is open: the background agent is not installed.
BkDeletePlanMessage: The plan stops. The backups it made are kept.
BkKindHelp: Incremental stores only what changed; archive keeps one file per backup; folder stays browsable in Explorer.
BkLiveHelp: By default running distributions and containers stop for a consistent copy and start again afterwards.
BkNeedTarget: Choose at least one thing to back up.
TermNone: No terminals open. Start one from a distribution or a container, or with New terminal.
SetBackupDirHelp: Manual and safety backups go here.
SetAgentHelp: Runs backup plans, restart policies and Compose autostart while the window is closed, as you, without administrator rights.
SetRestartSessionMessage: Every running container stops; the next command starts a new session with the saved settings.
SetAboutText: Manages WSL distributions, WSL Containers, Compose projects and backups. Licensed under GPL-3.0.
